verdict: Capati is slightly better. One piece has fewer calories than two slices of white bread, with almost the same protein.
why: 1 piece of capati is about 120 kcal. 2 slices of white bread are about 160 kcal.
Protein is almost the same: 4 g vs 5 g.
Fat is close too: 3 g vs 2 g. Not a big difference.
With white bread, it's easy to add more slices and spreads like margarine, kaya or jam. Capati is usually eaten one piece at a time with dhal.
when_a: White bread is okay for a quick breakfast at home. Make a sandwich with egg or tuna and some vegetables.
when_b: Capati is okay at the mamak instead of roti canai. Eat it with dhal and add an egg or tandoori chicken.
tip: Whatever bread you pick, add a protein source. Egg, chicken or dhal keeps you full longer than bread alone.

faq.q: Is mamak capati the same as homemade?
faq.a: Size and oil may differ by shop. Some brush on oil or margarine. It's still an estimated lighter option than roti canai.
Wholemeal bread usually has more fibre and is more filling. But white bread can fit too if the portion and what you pair it with are good.
